observations.publish: The bucket head is release-stored after the name field is written.
observations.consume: The finder plain-loaded the bucket and then the name. The name word was not a string.
observations.followedBy: An acquire load was added on that finder in the campaign runtime tree. The following stdlib run did not complete.

observations.note: identifier? had already accepted the syntax object, and identifier-symbol still returned a non-symbol. Replacing that value with generate-runtime-temporary produced unknown class _g200474_ while compiling std/string/utf8.ss and unknown class _g120303_ while compiling gerbil/runtime/util.ss. A fresh temporary is not the binding id.

A flag stored before pthread_join is not a still-joinable OS join error. qualify_nine_of_twelve admits 9/12 only from the three-line transcript OS-JOIN-ERROR, SAME-OWNER-JOIN 0, STILL-JOINABLE-THEN-SUCCESS with errno other than 22. The live milestone text is 8/12. The retained lifecycle-join-recovery stdout is only the banner line.

The first stdlib stopped in optimizer-resolve-class because time.ssi had no time.ssxi.ss. The later clean stdlib wrote time.ssxi.ss and declare-class for std/time/time#ExactTime::t. That removed this particular unknown class. It is not a TYPEID witness.

The lldb rerun did not stop in a signal. gxi exited 70 with heap overflow after writing an #f64 vector where the stock compiler writes a gensym. Refusing every non-symbol from identifier-symbol then stopped stdlib at sync/spinlock.ss:14 with detail #f, because #f is an absent identifier. #f must be returned. A vector still must not be emitted. This is not an exclusive ##wr-structure TYPEID witness and not a join recovery.
